brief: A planter cell fed by a vertical water riser through the floor, with a bin made for the pipe.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.requirement: Planter cell (cell configured as planter with soil and planting)
requirements.evidence: Single full hex cell at 0,0,0 with bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain-pvc filled to rim with soil and planted with basil-harvest (prop:1), visible from above (polar 10) and side (polar 62).

requirements.requirement: Fed by a vertical water riser through the floor
requirements.evidence: riser:0,0,0 vertical riser added via addRiser at 0,0,0 level 0 – penetrates floor of base piece:0,0,0;full to supply water to cell above.

requirements.requirement: Bin made for the pipe (PVC bore / pipe-compatible bin)
requirements.evidence: hex-bin-full-drain-pvc bin at 0,0,0 – full-depth drained bin with central PVC bore specifically for vertical riser pass-through; installed in same cell as riser, so pipe passes through bin floor without interference.

finish.summary: Built single-cell planter: full hex base with vertical water riser through the floor (0,0,0) and matching PVC-bore drained bin (hex-bin-full-drain-pvc) filled with soil and basil. Open faces capped, joints locked, meshClash clear, plant visible.

lines.label: Bin, full depth, drained, PVC bore

events.text: Your planter + pipe riser is on the way — I'll set up a floor-fed cell and its matching bin.

parts.name: Rod socket
parts.use: Stands a round tube up off a cell face, so a mast, a stake or a conduit riser is carried by the cluster.
